declaration.statement: The scanned basket (Every scanned non-benchmark name. The basket the strategy actually holds.), bought at each session's close and sold at the next open, returns more than zero net of a one-tick round trip.
declaration.costNote: One tick (1.0bp on a $100 name) charged against each night's own prior close. A MODEL, and the one the measured book exists to replace.
declaration.independenceBasis: Consecutive overnight returns share no bar — one close and the next open — so n is the effective sample and no overlap correction is owed. Names within a date are averaged before the series is formed, because the basket is one bet.
declaration.killCriteria: A net mean at or below zero once the record clears the detectable effect at t=3, or a control basket showing the same Sharpe — which would make it market drift.

declaration.statement: The scanned basket, bought at the 15:50 ask and sold into the next opening auction, returns more than zero — at prices that were actually quoted.
declaration.entry: 15:50 ET ask, from the recorded book
declaration.exit: official open of session D+1, as a market-on-open fill
declaration.costNote: The half-spread resting on the book at 15:50, taken as the ask against the mid. No exit spread is charged: a market-on-open order fills at the auction print and crosses no book. EXCLUDES market impact and auction imbalance, which a top-of-book quote cannot see.
declaration.independenceBasis: One mark, one auction, one night; no bar or quote contributes to two observations. Names within a date are averaged before the series is formed.
declaration.killCriteria: A net mean at or below zero once the paired drag against the close-to-open leg is distinguishable from zero, or a drag large enough to consume the premium.

declaration.statement: The top decile of 12-1 momentum outperforms the panel when MORE than half of it trades above its own 200-session average. Expressed as a held position: the top decile of the ranked panel against the equal-weighted panel over the same window. A RELATIVE return — the line can rise while the position loses money in a falling market.
declaration.entry: close of the decision session, 21-session rebalance
declaration.costNote: One tick against each held name's own entry price, multiplied by the decile turnover actually observed at each rebalance. Replaces the hypothesis's flat costPp, which is in win-rate space and models no turnover at all. The benchmark leg is not charged: it is a comparison, not a position.
declaration.independenceBasis: Periods step by the 21-session hold, so no bar contributes to two observations and no overlap correction is owed. Periods the regime gate closed are absent rather than zero, which is why turnover resets to 1 across a gap.
declaration.killCriteria: Retire if it fails the gate. If this and its down-regime complement look alike, breadth does not condition the long leg and the dossier must not gate on it.
